Q) LTXX/QAFXX/IV/NBO/E /000/999/3822N02559E357
A) LTBB LGGG B) 2612030600 C) 2612101000
E) NAVIGATIONAL WARNING TO ALL CONCERNED:

TURKIYE REQUESTED THE GREEK AIS TO MODIFY THE LIMITS OF THE 'GD' 
AREA OF GREEK NOTAM A4368/26 WHICH OVERLAPS TURKISH MILITARY FIRING 
EXERCISE AREA (NOTAM REQUEST MESSAGE 261235 LTAAYNYX NOV 2026) 
WITHIN INTERNATIONAL AIRSPACE. GREEK AIS DID NOT MODIFY THE SAID 
AREA, THEREFORE THE GREEK NOTAM A4368/26 IS NULL AND VOID. TURKISH 
NAVIGATIONAL WARNING NOTAM A4816/26 IS VALID AND EFFECTIVE.
